title: Reviewer statistics silently left out archived changes with no review record, so the incomplete-history warning understated the gap
resolution: The repository now counts archived changes without either file; text and JSON state that number apart from the derived changes, with a test, a spec scenario, and updated evidence.

title: The Makefile comment of the findings target did not list the reviewers command
resolution: The two-line comment now lists reviewers [--json] within the comment length rule.

title: An archived change with pass summaries but no findings file skipped the cross-file checks, so unchecked counts reached the statistics
resolution: A missing findings.jsonl beside passes.jsonl now counts as empty and the consistency checks run, with a test; design decision 4 and the spec and protocol wording follow.

title: The proposal and verification record said the index and checklist commands were unchanged, although they now refuse invalid pass summaries
resolution: Both records now say their output is unchanged and that they refuse to run on invalid or disagreeing pass summaries.

title: The protocol and the statistics requirement did not mention misses that name a pass without a record
resolution: The protocol and the Reviewer statistics requirement now name those misses, which are counted apart; the requirement stays at 467 characters.

title: Loading the repository listed the change directories twice and repeated the file existence checks
resolution: The missing files are now derived from the records already loaded for each change.

title: Pass summaries were parsed from a type named for findings, and the valid-output helper called its changes files
resolution: The source type is now RecordSource and the helper parameter is changes.
